006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.List;
009import java.util.Map;
010import java.util.stream.Stream;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapKey;
022import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
023import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
024
025/**
026 * Implements the XPath 3.1 <a href=
027 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-keys">map:keys</a>
028 * function.
029 */
030public final class MapKeys {
031  private static final String NAME = "keys";
032  @NonNull
033  static final IFunction SIGNATURE = IFunction.builder()
034      .name(NAME)
035      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS_MAP)
036      .deterministic()
037      .contextIndependent()
038      .focusIndependent()
039      .argument(IArgument.builder()
040          .name("map")
041          .type(IMapItem.type())
042          .one()
043          .build())
044      .returnType(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
045      .returnZeroOrMore()
046      .functionHandler(MapKeys::execute)
047      .build();
048
049  private MapKeys() {
050    // disable construction
051  }
052
053  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
054  @NonNull
055  private static ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> execute(@NonNull IFunction function,
056      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
057      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
058      IItem focus) {
059    IMapItem<?> map = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0).getFirstItem(true)));
060
061    return ISequence.of(keys(map));
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * An implementation of XPath 3.1 <a href=
066   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-map-keys">map:keys</a>.
067   *
068   * @param map
069   *          the map to get the keys for
070   * @return a stream of map keys
071   */
072  @SuppressWarnings("null")
073  @NonNull
074  public static Stream<IAnyAtomicItem> keys(@NonNull Map<IMapKey, ?> map) {
075    return map.keySet().stream()
076        .map(IMapKey::getKey);
077  }
078}
